faqs.a:
Nothing in this Code shall be construed as a limitation upon the power of the city
               engineer to correct obvious typographical or compositional errors, provided:
(1)
Such corrections shall not change the legal effect of this Code or any part thereof.
(2)
Such corrections will be reported to the city council.
(
Ord. No. 4809
, § 1, 7-18-2022)
